segments.name: Beauty products
segments.description: Sells cosmetics and other beauty products in China and provides brand management operation services to brand partners.
segments.evidence: The single reportable segment contains sales of cosmetics and other beauty products and provision of operation services.

revenueModel.text: Online marketplaces, distributors and end consumers pay Able View for brand partners' products it resells; brand management itself earns no separate revenue.
revenueModel.evidence: Instead, the Company generates revenue from the sales of the products of its brand partners.

changes.text: Shanghai Jingyue, a former subsidiary, was disposed of in June 2025.
changes.evidence: All of these fines were paid, and Shanghai Jingyue was no longer a subsidiary of ours on June 27, 2025.
